``` {r setup, include = FALSE}
#function to label fragment ion types
classify_fragment <- function(ion_type, base_type, fragment_sequence, modified_fragment) {
  
  ion_type <- trimws(as.character(ion_type))
  base_type <- trimws(as.character(base_type))
  modified_fragment <- trimws(as.character(modified_fragment))
  
  # Check for remainder ions
  if (ion_type %in% c("b^", "y^", "a^", "MH^")) {
    return("Remainder_ion")
  }
  
  # Check for labile ions
  if (ion_type %in% c("b~", "y~", "a~", "MH~")) {
    return("Labile_ion")
  }
  
  # Check for standard b, y, a ions (exact match)
  if (ion_type %in% c("b", "y", "a") || base_type %in% c("b", "y", "a")) {
    
    # Use modified_fragment column, not fragment_sequence
    bracket_values <- str_match_all(modified_fragment, "\\[([^\\]]+)\\]")[[1]]
    
    if (nrow(bracket_values) > 0) {
      numeric_vals <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(str_replace(bracket_values[, 2], "^\\+", ""))
      )
      numeric_vals <- numeric_vals[!is.na(numeric_vals)]
      
      if (length(numeric_vals) > 0 && any(abs(numeric_vals) > 205)) {
        return("Intact_modified_ion")
      } else {
        return("Non-modified_ion")
      }
    } else {
      return("Non-modified_ion")
    }
  }
  
  return(NA_character_)
}

# Recode helper
recode_groups <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(group = recode(group,
      "HCD_20" = "CE - 20%",
      "HCD_25" = "CE - 25%",
      "HCD_30" = "CE - 30%",
      "HCD_35" = "CE - 35%",
      "HCD_40" = "CE - 40%"
    ))
}

recode_groups_2 <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(group = recode(group,
      "HCD_20" = "20",
      "HCD_25" = "25",
      "HCD_30" = "30",
      "HCD_35" = "35",
      "HCD_40" = "40"
    ))
}
```

```{r}
# Plot function — legend hidden, uses fixed colour scale
make_pie_row <- function(data, meta, ion, title_label) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(base_type == ion) %>%
    recode_groups()
  
  n_labels <- meta %>%
    filter(base_type == ion) %>%
    recode_groups() %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n_distinct(Header), .groups = "drop")
  
  group_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(n_labels$group, "\n(n = ", n_labels$n, ")"),
    n_labels$group
  )
  
  plot_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = Fragment_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = pct_label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
    ) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = fragment_colours,
      labels = fragment_labels,
      name   = "Ion type",
      drop   = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 5,
               labeller = labeller(group = group_labels)) +
    labs(title = title_label, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_blank(),
      panel.background  = element_blank(),
      text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line         = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks        = element_blank(),
      axis.text         = element_blank(),
      plot.background   = element_blank(),
      strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      strip.background  = element_blank(),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size)),
      legend.position        = "bottom",
      legend.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80")
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Plot function — bar chart version, same column names as pie version
make_bar_row <- function(data, meta, title_label) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    recode_groups() %>%
    mutate(base_type = factor(base_type, levels = c("y", "b", "MH")))
  
  n_labels <- meta %>%
    recode_groups() %>%
    filter(base_type %in% c("y", "b", "MH")) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n_distinct(Header), .groups = "drop")
  
  group_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(n_labels$group, "\n(n = ", n_labels$n, ")"),
    n_labels$group
  )
  
  plot_data %>%
    mutate(Fragment_type = factor(Fragment_type, levels = names(fragment_colours))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = base_type, y = pct, fill = Fragment_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 5, sprintf("%.1f%%", pct), "")),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3,
      colour = "black",
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = fragment_colours,
      labels = fragment_labels,
      name   = "Ion type",
      drop   = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ group, ncol = 5,
      labeller = labeller(group = group_labels)
    ) +
    labs(title = title_label, x = "Fragment ion", y = "Fragment Ion Relative Abundance (%)") +
    theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA),
      panel.background  = element_blank(),
      text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text         = element_text(
                            size   = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size),
                            colour = "black"),
      axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      plot.background   = element_blank(),
      strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      strip.background  = element_blank(),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size)),
      legend.position        = "bottom",
      legend.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80")
    )
}
```

```{r}

data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(!grepl("rev_", Protein)) %>%
  filter(grepl("N", Mods..variable.)) %>%
  filter(Peptide == "NVSWATGR")

data_filtered$backbone_coverage_partial<- (data_filtered$backbone_coverage_partial/data_filtered$backbone_coverage_potential)*100
data_filtered$backbone_coverage_intact <- (data_filtered$backbone_coverage_overall/data_filtered$backbone_coverage_potential)*100

# ── Shared data prep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


coverage_long <- data_filtered %>%
  select(Replicate, Group, Peptide, 
         backbone_coverage_partial, backbone_coverage_intact, index, Spectrum.file) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(backbone_coverage_partial, backbone_coverage_intact),
    names_to  = "coverage_type",
    values_to = "coverage_pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_type = factor(
      coverage_type,
      levels = c("backbone_coverage_intact", "backbone_coverage_partial"),
      labels = c("Intact (y/b/a)", "Partial Coverage (y/y*/b/b*/a/a*)")
    )
  )

coverage_long_rep <- coverage_long %>%
  group_by( Replicate, coverage_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(coverage_pct = mean(coverage_pct))


# ── N peptides per facet label ────────────────────────────────────────────────

n_coverage <- coverage_long %>%
  distinct(Peptide, Group, Replicate,  index, Spectrum.file) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_peptides = n(), .groups = "drop")


# ── Boxplot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ggplot(aes(x = coverage_type, y = coverage_pct, fill = coverage_type)) +

  ) +

    title = "Backbone Sequence Coverage by Number of Modifications",
```

#Annotated TIC by ion type 
```{r}
####Intensity anaylsis 

df_shared <- data_filtered %>%
  filter(!grepl("Custom_Ion", neutral_loss))%>%
  filter(!grepl("H2O|NH3", ion_type))

classify_fragment <- function(ion_type, base_type, fragment_sequence, modified_fragment) {
  
  ion_type <- trimws(as.character(ion_type))
  base_type <- trimws(as.character(base_type))
  modified_fragment <- trimws(as.character(modified_fragment))
  
  # Check for remainder ions (e.g. b^, b^², y^³)
  if (grepl("\\^", ion_type) || ion_type %in% c("MH^")) {
    return("Remainder_ion")
  }
  
  # Check for labile ions (e.g. b~, b~², y~³)
  if (grepl("~", ion_type)) {
    return("Labile_ion")
  }
  
  # Check for standard b, y, a ions (exact match)
  if (ion_type %in% c("b", "y", "a", "MH") || base_type %in% c("b", "y", "a", "MH")) {
    
    bracket_values <- str_match_all(modified_fragment, "\\[([^\\]]+)\\]")[[1]]
    
    if (nrow(bracket_values) > 0) {
      numeric_vals <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(str_replace(bracket_values[, 2], "^\\+", ""))
      )
      numeric_vals <- numeric_vals[!is.na(numeric_vals)]
      
      if (length(numeric_vals) > 0 && any(abs(numeric_vals) > 205)) {
        return("Intact_modified_ion")
      } else {
        return("Non-modified_ion")
      }
    } else {
      return("Non-modified_ion")
    }
  }
  
  return(NA_character_)
}

df_shared$Fragment_type <- mapply(
  classify_fragment,
  df_shared$ion_type,
  df_shared$base_type,
  df_shared$fragment_sequence,
  df_shared$modified_fragment  # <-- added this
)
```

#HexNAc(3)Hex(4)NeuAc(1)
#oxoium ion signals
```{r}
####Intensity anaylsis 

df_shared <- data_filtered %>%
  filter(grepl("Custom_Ion", neutral_loss)) %>%
  mutate(
    ion_name      = ion_type,,
    raw_intensity = intensity,
    rel_intensity = raw_intensity / Max_Intensity * 100
  ) 

# --- Average relative intensity per ion × group × glycan ---
diag_summary_glycan <- df_shared %>%
  group_by(group, Glycans, ion_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_rel_intensity = mean(rel_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
    n                  = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = recode(group,
      "HCD_20" = "20", "HCD_25" = "25", "HCD_30" = "30",
      "HCD_35" = "35", "HCD_40" = "40")
  )


# --- Order ions by overall mean intensity across all glycans ---
ion_order_glycan <- diag_summary_glycan %>%
  group_by(ion_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(overall_mean = mean(mean_rel_intensity), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(overall_mean)) %>%
  pull(ion_name)

diag_summary_glycan <- diag_summary_glycan %>%
  mutate(ion_name = factor(ion_name, levels = ion_order_glycan))

# --- How many unique glycans? Build a colour palette that always has enough colours ---
n_ions <- n_distinct(diag_summary_glycan$ion_name)
ion_colours <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(9, n_ions), "Set1"))(n_ions)

# --- Count peptides per glycan for informative strip labels ---
glycan_counts <- df_shared %>%
  filter(!is.na(Glycans) & Glycans != "") %>%
  group_by(Glycans) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_pep = n_distinct(Sequence..unformatted.), .groups = "drop")

diag_summary_glycan <- diag_summary_glycan %>%
  left_join(glycan_counts, by = "Glycans") %>%
  mutate(glycan_label = sprintf("%s\n(n=%d peptides)", Glycans, n_pep))


diag_summary_glycan <- diag_summary_glycan %>%
  filter(ion_name %in% c("HexNAc", "Hex-HexNAc", "NeuAc", "NeuAc – H2O", "HexNAc(1)Hex(1)NeuAc(1)")) %>%
  filter(n_pep > 9)


# ============================================================
# SECTION B2 — DIAGNOSTIC ION RELATIVE INTENSITY BY GLYCAN
# One page per glycan, saved to PDF
# ============================================================

unique_glycans <- unique(diag_summary_glycan$Glycans)

pdf("diagnostic_ions_by_glycan.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)

for (glycan in unique_glycans) {
  
  plot_data <- diag_summary_glycan %>%
    filter(Glycans == glycan)
  
  # Skip if somehow empty
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) next
  
  n_pep    <- unique(plot_data$n_pep)
  n_ions_g <- n_distinct(plot_data$ion_name)
  ion_colours_g <- colorRampPalette(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(9, n_ions_g), "Set1")
  )(n_ions_g)
  
  p <- plot_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = mean_rel_intensity, colour = ion_name, group = ion_name)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ion_colours_g, name = "Diagnostic Ion") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = glycan,
      subtitle = sprintf("n = %d peptides", n_pep),
      x        = "Collisional Energy",
      y        = "Mean Relative Intensity (% base peak)"
    ) +
    theme_foundation(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_blank(),
      panel.background  = element_blank(),
      text              = element_text(colour = "black"),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((title_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
      axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
      axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", size = line_size),
      axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1)),
      axis.title.y      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 2),
      axis.title.x      = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
      axis.text         = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      plot.background   = element_blank(),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size), colour = "black"),
      legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold",
                            size = rel((axis_text_rel_size + base_size) / base_size)),
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80")
    )
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()

message(sprintf("PDF saved: %d pages (%d glycans)", length(unique_glycans), length(unique_glycans)))
```
